The name is associated with the god of music, Saraswati, who holds a bansuri, a type of bamboo flute, in her hands. The name Bansi carries the meaning “Bamboo flute” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bansi usually hope their child will grow to embody bamboo flute and live with faith, good character and purpose.
